name: Gelej (Hungary)
description: White field with a serrated border of red and green triangles, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Gelej: a green shield with a yellow chevron and a bunch of grapes, with a helm, red and white mantling and a scroll.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
